aid.title: Villanova - International Student Financial Aid Process

test_policy.notes: Test-optional through the 2026-27 admission campaign (class of 2031). Official or self-reported scores accepted; SAT/ACT superscored across dates. Scores reported by Nov 10 (ED I/EA) or Jan 31 (ED II/RD) are considered. Homeschooled applicants (more than one full year) must submit scores.

requirements.supplemental_essays: Villanova writing supplements (Common App Member School section or Coalition Part II).
requirements.notes: One teacher recommendation required; a counselor letter is optional but the counselor Secondary School Report and official transcript are required. Senior-year grades required for ED II, RD and deferred applicants. Villanova does not conduct interviews or consider demonstrated interest. Need-based aid needs both FAFSA and CSS Profile (code 2959). International applicants submit a Certification of Finances and bank statement.

deadlines.label: Early Action
deadlines.notes: Non-binding; decision by Jan 20; deposit by May 1.

deadlines.label: Early Decision I
deadlines.notes: Binding; decision by Dec 1; deposit within two weeks of admission.

deadlines.label: Early Decision II
deadlines.notes: Binding; decision by Feb 15; deposit within two weeks of admission.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Non-binding; decision by Apr 1; deposit by May 1.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived if English is a native language spoken at home, or more than three consecutive years of English-medium secondary school at the time of application.

aid.notes: Admission for international first-year students is need-aware. Merit scholarships (awarded by Admission, incl. nomination for the Presidential Scholarship) and limited need-based grants are available; no merit or need-based aid for international transfer students.
